craft_notes: Sthāyin: inside when unguarded. Rows: enter then all-within. Read aloud: gathering in.

lines: But where a guardless wold without doth lie,
enter thou, and on the altar's edge alone
the outward-host, the portal-god-ring worship do,
as shown before, and rite, yet nothing without.
l4.sanskrit_cite: agupte tu bahiḥsthāne sati praviśya maṇḍalasthaṇḍilāgra eva bāhyaparivāradvāradevatācakrapūjāṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca nyāsādi kuryāt na bahiḥ
